name: Vera Aesthetics

meta.note: DEMONSTRATION brand — runs on an MSS-owned reference IG account. Manual publish only for the POC; Meta auto-publish is deferred to Phase 2.

demonstrationNote: Vera Aesthetics is a fictional clinic built by Main Stage Studio to prove the content engine end to end. It is not a real business and takes no patients. Every public surface labels it as an MSS demonstration. All results imagery is illustrative, never fabricated real patients.

branding.note: Bone leaf mark (light raster) for the logo bug on photo/still slides — those carry a navy scrim, so the bone version reads. On the navy/bone/gold card text slides the mark is already part of the template footer. ffmpeg has no SVG decoder, so the overlay must use the PNG raster (assets/vera-mark.png is the navy variant for light backgrounds; assets/vera-mark.svg is the editable source).
